exposure: National Diabetes Data Group (NDDG) criteria for early-onset gestational diabetes mellitus (Early-GDM)
International Association of Diabetes and Pregnancy Study Groups (IADPSG) criteria for Early-GDM
American Diabetes Association (ADA) criteria for Early-GDM
cohort: The study cohort consisted of 3200 women, categorized as 400 with Early-GDM, 800 with GDM, and 2000 with Non-GDM, all initially diagnosed according to the NDDG criteria.
finding: Replacing NDDG criteria with IADPSG or ADA criteria for diagnosing Early-GDM would result in a significant number of women with abnormal glucose tolerance and higher risk of adverse perinatal outcomes being deprived of early treatment, while others with lower risk would be treated.
